notes.title: Update 0.10.14
notes.notes:
Flavor text has been added to all modules to help players understand the gameplay and world setting. This text will appear when you hover over the name of a module on a panel displaying module information, or over an item on a screen, such as the module collection rate on the scoreboard.

Additions

Added flavor text to all modules.
Skill: Archaic Rule prevents projectiles that have failed hit test from hitting the skill user as stray bullets. (Replicates behavior up to version 0.10.11)
Skill: Adaptive Defense increases defense based on damage taken in a previous round.
Skill: In-Order Modules with remaining AP do not take HP damage.

Bug Fixes

Fixed: The game crashed when destroying the attack target in the DPS simulator.

Other Modifications

M.Cores (Balancer, Dream, Foreigner, General, Space, Sun, Tempest), Dragon Armor, and Barrage Laser Rev.B can now be crafted via modding.
Improved rendering quality of partially colored text.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45493307/cd4a34fbf1a34f15f120757317faeaca8725a4d3.png

notes.title: Update 0.10.13
notes.notes:
Added skills to improve unwieldy weapons, such as those with a wide AoE radius or high heat-generating optical weapons.

Additions

CATs: 1 small CAT and 6 normal-size CATs.
Skill: Compressed Explosion increases area damage instead of reducing the area of effect.
Skill: Overheat Radiation increases damage dealt by optical weapons in overheat state.
Skill: Heater Shield increases defense as heat level rises.

Bug Fixes

Fixed: Occasionally crashed on startup, and this was more likely to occur with CPUs with more cores.

Other Modifications

Blueprints and codices can now be used while exploring.
The chance of unintentional hits to certain objects like CATs was reduced.
Adjusted required attribute values and appearance areas for many skills. 
Added a tab for moddable modules in the factory.
Overall, reduced turn rates of cores/drives.
Made it possible to destroy Shield Systems with Shield Neutralizer. 
Adjusted skills and AI of some CATs.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45493307/2544882df023d5a16691d99d7ae81b6535e7cf51.png

notes.title: Update 0.10.12
notes.notes:
A new facility called "Remote Factory" has been added to the exploration map (excluding First Cat Mode).
For existing save data, their maps will be updated if you return to the garage and then head out to explore.

Additions

Remote Factory is a facility where you can perform factory functions while exploring.
Module: Turret Overrider is a special weapon that turns enemy artillery and turrets to your side.
Skill: Sixth Sense displays the direction of a nearest enemy CAT.
Skill: Cyber Conversion removes the armor-ignoring trait of cyber weapons but increases their damage by 16 times.

Bug Fixes

Fixed: The AP/HP gauges for friendly artillery and turrets had the same color as those for the enemy.
Fixed: Status effect Accidental Firing was not applied to Flex Turrets.

Other Modifications

Improved hit rates of Grappling Hook, Remora Anchor, and Space Hopper. Remora Anchor no longer requires ammunition.
Grappling Hook, Remora Anchor, and skills that target an object can now select static objects outside of sight.
If a projectile fails in its hit-test to the target object upon firing and flies on a trajectory that intersects with the target, it will now be hit-tested as a stray shot, just like other objects.
When a projectile hits something other than the object that passed the hit test at the time of firing and causes damage, it is now logged as an unintentional hit.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45493307/854705a910a981046a0fa1cdd99fd592342f9f28.png

notes.title: Update 0.10.11
notes.notes:
A certain number of allies (CATs, artillery/turrets, friendly sensors) are now placed on playfields in advance. The amount placed depends on the current layer and how many CATs you can deploy.

Additions

Skill: Sniping increases accuracy when attacking without moving.
Item: Rollback Batch rewinds time to the previous round.
Item: Reset Batch rewinds time to the start of battle.
Module: Toxic Dartgun is a special weapon for the early stages that deals continuous damage.
CATs: Plankton and Tsuchinoko are equipped with Toxic DartGun.

Bug Fixes

Fixed: The range of Pulse Rifle and Ion Storm was shorter than the displayed value.
Fixed: When multiple effects that reduce a same parameter by a percentage were stacked, the reduction amount was displayed as -100%.
Fixed: It was possible to summon any number of CATs using Friend Phones, contrary to the description.
Fixed: Skill effects could not create walls or fences on squares where floor-type objects were placed.
Fixed: The effect range of Wall Generator was different from what was displayed.

Other Modifications

Further expansion of playfield variations.
The probability of friendly CATs and turrets being generated on a playfield has increased.
Removed Energy Usage +100% from the debuffs granted by Terminals and Virus Barrels.
Added an image when exiting the game.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45493307/29ffe3a2029c7b4b4f730fab8e1bf5bf6bbbef51.png

notes.title: Update 0.10.10
notes.notes:
The probability of generating chests and the expected value of items obtained when destroying boxes, barrels, pots, etc. have been slightly buffed.

Additions

Object: Potted Plant — When destroyed, there is a low chance of obtaining an item. (Same type of object as Pot)
Item: Friend Phone summons a random CAT that will be your ally for the duration of a battle.
Status effect: Teleportation Sickness causes random teleportation at random times.

Other Modifications

Enhanced variety of playfields.
Information is now displayed when the pointer hovers over items in the inventory screen.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45493307/ec40536fa44540dbba0db01a9298c9afcb0c326f.png

notes.title: Update 0.10.9
notes.notes:
This and the next few updates will focus on expanding the variety of playfields (battle maps).

Additions

Vending Machine is a device that can be unlocked repeatedly to obtain random items in exchange for pixels.
Ice Wall is a wall that lowers the heat levels of the surrounding environment.
Drone Attractor is a type of alarm that gathers drones within a playfield.
Thicket and Liquid Wall can be passed through, but they partially block sensors and projectiles. (Similar to Dark Zone)

Other Modifications

Predicted energy increase/decrease rates are now displayed in the command menu during battle scenes.
🐈 .NET runtime is included. This is a countermeasure for environment-dependent issues.


Changes marked with 🐈 were inspired by user feedback. Thank you for your participation!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45493307/ec95438612d849b2d44a3a5119d8b9bb76b36e18.png

notes.title: Update 0.10.8
notes.notes:
New upgrades have been added to all carriers except Bomber-Shark.

Additions

Ammo Box Installation (Sea-Dragon) installs an ammo box.
Anti-Sensor Coating (Aqua-Manta) gives a status effect that prevents detection under 25% Visibility.
Make Friends (Sky-Dolphin) turns a neutral CAT into an ally.
Mining-Rig Installation (Minor-Whale) installs a rig that moves forward while destroying obstacles.
Skill: Multi-Missile 3x triples the number of guided missiles fired by other skill effects.
Enemy CATs: Magicbolt, Pluton

Bug Fixes

Fixed: Replay did not work properly when using Extra Deployment of Minor-Whale.
Fixed: The movement distance of some objects was different from their Movement.
Fixed: Debuffs such as Damage Taken +100% were not applied to Rotating Floor.
Fixed: Ammo explosion damage was sometimes not displayed correctly in the battle log.
Fixed: In the battle log, some optical weapons' damage was sometimes mixed up with other weapons' damage.

Other Modifications

Dark Zone now blocks some projectiles, mainly from optical and cyber weapons.
Improved AI of Block Breaker, which refrains from ineffective attacks.
Improved AI when attacking static objects outside of sensing range.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45493307/e5ef8dc8f2bf13f9b824c0881209e9971711504a.png

notes.title: Update 0.10.7
notes.notes:
CAT Builder tutorials can be run from an event placed when a new game is started.

Additions

Added tutorials for the CAT Builder.

Bug Fixes

Fixed: In CAT stats, 1 was added per connector to the displayed value of maximum energy consumption.
Fixed: The description of Sensing +X% (skill) sometimes differed from its actual effect.
Fixed: In First Cat mode, if a broken module was equipped at the beginning of a battle, pixels were significantly reduced at the end of the battle.
Fixed: Processor utilization was excessively high while the window was minimized.
Fixed: The frame rate of background drawing was low when the DPS simulator was turned off in the CAT Builder test screen.

Other Modifications

Improved the algorithm for automatic module replacement in the CAT Builder.


Changes marked with 🐈 were inspired by user feedback. Thank you for your participation!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45493307/bc5bd1fe461ad620f954c81e61b37accaa94c39b.png

notes.title: Update 0.10.6
notes.notes:
Update to add skills and to reduce clicks by extending automatic controls.

Additions

Skill: Body Swap swaps positions with another CAT of the same size.
Skill: Optimization ES-80% reduces shield energy consumption by 80% for shields at maximum durability.
Skill: Photosynthesis allows users to avoid consuming carrier energy.

Other Modifications

Most passive skills now support automatic control mode.
Adjusted prices for ammo packs and carrier upgrades.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45493307/5a96c28b394757c2773bd79ab61e5d060cc1bd42.png

notes.title: Update 0.10.5
notes.notes:
Redesign

🐈The tutorial has been redesigned as a step-by-step guide.

Bug Fixes

Fixed: The tutorial completion achievement cannot be unlocked in First Cat mode.

Other Modifications

An Emergency Patch can now also restore Armor Points to a targeted module.


Changes marked with 🐈 were inspired by user feedback. Thank you for your participation!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45493307/7b46d53fd5f40895532057b2d686254b2e89a930.png

notes.title: Update 0.10.4
notes.notes:
Through ongoing tweaks to weapon parameters and fixes to bugs that had a significant impact on short-range weapons, the practicality of melee weapons has been greatly improved.

Additions

Module: Fishing Spear is a high-DPS melee weapon that can be used early in the game.

Bug Fixes

Fixed: Some melee weapons (Stinger, Pile Driver, Unicorn, Laser Needle, Blast Lance) could never hit the target when used at the edge of their range.
Fixed: When attacking while approaching from out of range, the first shot would always miss.
Fixed: A CAT in a confused state would attack ignoring the firing angle limit.

Other Modifications

Changed the effect of Chest of Ray. Area damage → Fires beams in all directions.
Merged W, X, and Y mod kits.
The disadvantages of the skills Rapid Boot +100% and Ramming have been reduced.
Improved readability of area damage/effect logs.
Text displayed sequentially in dialogs now immediately follows language changes.
Weapons with a long time remaining before the next shot will have a reduced contribution to the turn direction decision.
Improved CAT behavior when attacking out-of-view coordinates where a static object is present.
Added a visual effect when an object is triggered by an effect of another object.
Event icons now change depending on the event state.
Updated graphics for shields with Ap/Ai/At/Ae derivatives.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45493307/e47ae75284a9956901425c22e646ced623b73e1d.png

notes.title: Update 0.10.3
notes.notes:
Additions

Added a feature to modify modules (create derived modules) in the factory.
Added hundreds of derived modules and tweaked the performance balance.
Added 24 types of enemy CATs.
Expanded a variety of effects when a terminal is successfully unlocked.

Bug Fixes

Fixed: Some events were not displayed in tutorials other than First Cat mode.
Fixed: Some events limited to First Cat mode were also displayed in other modes.
(patch-1) Fixed: Localization error in the pilot name "Venetian".


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45493307/596217886273ac44293b10d0610a1260f1d4ea35.png

notes.title: Update 0.10.2
notes.notes:
Additions

Item: Cleanup Batch removes buffs and debuffs that expire over time.
Supported manual setting of display scaling factor.
Application-specific mouse pointers.

Other Modifications

(Windows 11) Changed title bar style.
More variations of the Virus Barrel effect applied to objects other than CATs and turrets.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45493307/78efa479e65269619a307fa863676114f2461d9e.png

notes.title: Update 0.10.1
notes.notes:
Additions

🐈Added First Cat game mode (difficulty) for beginners.
This mode is designed for beginners and allows you to focus on playing CAT battles.
To make the game system easier to understand , the following elements are disabled.

Garage
Events: Portal, Energy Station, Repair Station, Remote Repository, Arena, Pixel Mining
Carrier: Energy, Storage, Upgrade
Story
Pilot Motivation
Gifts, Blueprints, Codices, Pixel Packs, Energy Packs

All CATs are fully recovered after each battle in exchange for pixels. As a result, your pixels may go negative, but there is no penalty other than not being able to buy items in the shops.
As you progress through each layer, one pilot is added, and the game is completed when you conquer the fourth floor.

Bug Fixes

Fixed: Some data was missing from the statistics when the game was completed.
Fixed: The layout of the tooltip for "Required Attributes" may break.
Fixed: In the Result dialog, the rendering of some modules may be distorted and the orientation is not reflected.
Fixed: A CAT recovering from Confusion or Berserk would continue to attack allies during the round.
Fixed: Clicking on a CAT outside the visible area targeted for auto-attack would deselect it.

Other Modifications

🐈Adjusted overall weapon performance. Here are the major changes.
[table]
[tr]
[th]Buffs[/th]
[td]Burst Artillery, Practical Cannon, Blazing Cannon, Charged EM Cannon, Purgatory,
Chain Pile, Pile Driver, Combat Batton, Harpoon Cannon, Plasma Blade, Eraser[/td]
[/tr]
[tr]
[th]Nerfs[/th]
[td]Basic Missile, Fast Missile, Polar Star, Dividing Missle,
Purger, Shooting Star, Backdoor Missile[/td]
[/tr]
[/table]
Increased pixels gained from scrapped modules that could not be looted after battle.
🐈Changed the equipment for Base Metal.
Removed the prerequisite skill for Evasion +8.
Adjusted sector generation parameters.
Improved item drop rate when destroying objects.


Changes marked with 🐈 were inspired by user feedback. Thank you for your participation!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45493307/fc0fd6cff8659b19f531c699d65da806546bee3c.png

notes.title: Update 0.9.6
notes.notes:
Additions

Item: Sounding Rocket temporarily shows all nodes in a sector.
Item: Meowpener reduces the lock strength of a locked object.

Bug Fixes

Fixed: If there is an error in a localization definition file, the game may crash at the time the error text is displayed.
Fixed: Carrier energy may exceed the maximum value after a battle.

Other Modifications

Yuzuha's initial skill has been changed to Counter Armor.

notes.title: Update 0.9.5
notes.notes:
General Improvements

🐈The CAT Builder test screen has been redesigned to allow for combat simulation.
When using the item Emergency Patch during battle, you can now select a module to restore HP.
Enabled to use the item Restoration EXE during battle.

Additions

Skill Critical Strike: Melee weapon damage to HP is increased by 8 times.
Skill Dash!: Movement +50%. Can only be combined with weapons and skills with a range of 5 or less.

Bug Fixes

Fixed: AP-ignoring attacks did not penetrate modules.
Fixed: When using Core Shooting and Concentration at the same time, Concentration did not function.
Fixed: The effect duration of plugin items was different from their descriptions.

Changes marked with 🐈 were inspired by user feedback. Thank you for your participation!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45493307/45d3adddf315e247d6d7a523db2493d9b722e844.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45493307/63ef9938941581d9c9aebb696c417e79fa8f39b8.png

notes.title: Update 0.9.4 Demo
notes.notes:
General Improvements

🐈Arena entry fee has been made free.
Energy costs when returning directly to the garage have been made free.
House Cat difficulty: Repair costs at repair stations have been lowered.
House Cat difficulty: Energy and repair costs at the garage have been reduced.
🐈Added rewards for victory in capture battles.
🐈House Cat difficulty: Added rewards for defeating CATs other than child CATs.
🐈Added various shortcut key assignments.
🐈Added a batch operation button to CAT Move and Attack menu.
🐈Added explanation of effects to some object information.
🐈CATs within range of explosives will now avoid attacking those explosives. (Except for weapons with individual target settings and targets with "High" attack priority.)
🐈Static cloaked objects will now be visible once detected, even if visibility is below 100%.
🐈Rings around control systems and other objects can be seen even if they overlap with the field.
The mouse cursor is hidden when using a gamepad.

Bug Fixes

Fixed: When a moving object set as an attack target is outside the sensor range, the "!" icon does not appear in the attack menu.
Fixed: The key/button operation to create a new CAT is enabled on the screen for selecting a pilot to board.
🐈Fixed: Corrected Distress Beacon dialog title.

Changes marked with 🐈 were inspired by user feedback. Thank you for your participation!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45493307/b10e51d278b7371c6243535dfd733d4bc30abe79.png

notes.title: Update 0.9.3 Demo
notes.notes:
Bug Fixes

Fixed: Using certain characters in a CAT's name will cause those characters to multiply.
🐈Fixed: Deleting data in the continue scene may cause the game to crash.
Fixed: If certain character patterns are used in a handle name, pilot call sign, or CAT name, they will not be displayed correctly.
Fixed: Debuff "Uncontrollable turning" does not work on turrets.
Fixed: Focus control does not work properly when a battle ends while the CAT Detail Panel is displayed.

General Improvements

Increased the amount of initial supplies in the repository.
Salvageable items are placed in several nodes. (Updated each time you return to the garage)
Added a confirmation message when the target of a chase skill is not set as an attack target.
🐈Highlighting of unfinished tutorials and unviewed video boards.

Changes marked with 🐈 were inspired by user feedback. Thank you for your participation!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45493307/2c4677db379dbd28f322b1b0702056b6b33bce96.png

notes.title: Update 0.9.2 Demo
notes.notes:
Bug Fixes

Fixed: Steam Overlay does not accept mouse operations.
🐈Fixed: If the operating system's language setting is set to express decimal points as something other than "dots", bullet speeds and hit rates will be abnormal.
Fixed: Items multiply when right-clicking to collect in the salvage dialog.
Fixed: If you have many CATs, it is difficult to sort them in the stats menu.
Fixed: Inertial scrolling does not work on lists that scroll horizontally.
🐈Fixed: On very rare occasions, the game would crash when switching to an exploration scene.

General improvements

Improved operability with touchscreen, pen, and touchpad.
Improved key repeat response time for arrow keys.
Change logs can now be opened and closed.

Changes marked with 🐈 were inspired by user feedback. Thank you for your participation!
